title: Lajpal Raza Mola, Eh Zaaminay Ghareeban
body:
Eh Zaaminay Ghareeban, Lajpal Raza Mola
<<DIVIDER>>
Uthkay Kafan Cho Waikho, Haye (x2) Sada Haal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola.
<<DIVIDER>>
Edhi Chaiti Kanu Paiyan Mola Raza Judaiyan
Lutiyan Nay Badshaiyan Hogayiyan Nay Tabaiyan
Baghdad Day Qaidi Da, Haye (x2) Haye Laal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola.
<<DIVIDER>>
Syed Nun Zehar Milya Dil Qaidiyan Da Haliya
Paa Beyriyan Jo Chaliya Markay Zindan Chon Waliya
Abid Tay Musa Kazim, Haye (x2) Bay Haal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaiyan Mout Diyan Chawan Bhena Wakhdiyan Rawan
Aj Ron Layi Bulawan Karbal Gaiyan Jo Maawan
Bhena Da Vichora Eh, Haye (x2) Teray Naal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola.
<<DIVIDER>>
Syed Di Qurbani Hay Khoon Di Rawani
Karbal Wali Kahaani Kha Mout Gayi Jawani
Duniya Tun Turr Paiya Eh, Haye (x2) Bay Misaal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola.
<<DIVIDER>>
Eh Dardan Day Khazanay Adil Nohay Bananay
Harfan Yun Ho Na Janay Mola Tu Yun Likhanay
Meray Vain Nun Paray Ga, Haye(x2) Haar Saal Raza Mola
Lajpal Raza Mola
